title: just-deliver catalog descriptor
description: Identifies the catalog and declares its environment types and platforms. The catalog is versioned as one unit and the version is recorded on every deployment. Exactly one file of this kind per catalog.

x-jd.message: required: this jd selects implementations by platform; a catalog written for an older jd lacks it, so add it and key each component's and runtime's implementations by platform (see catalog/catalog.yaml).

version.description: Catalog version, recorded next to the definition SHA of every deployment.

platforms.description: The platforms (clouds), declared once: an environment definition or descriptor of any other platform is an error, and implementations and shared resources name one of these (docs/architecture/model.md section 3).

environmentTypes.description: The environment types, declared once: an environment definition or descriptor of any other type is an error. Names use the requirement-type pattern; `default` is not a type (docs/architecture/model.md section 5).

layer.description: Which `jd env up` layer an environment of this type is: `shared` deploys the `scope: shared` resources, `environment` the `scope: environment` resources and the offered components' environment parts. Implementations are keyed by `environment` types only.

approval.description: true: an environment of this type must carry an `approval` block, so it cannot be written ungated. Any type may carry one; the block is what gates.
